methodology.excursion: individual recorded liquidation-side ticks; ask for these shorts; received_at timestamps, e5/100000 prices; no candles/interpolation/new broker requests
methodology.post_close_anchor: actual exit fill; sign-adjusted favourable price movement divided by original R or broker pip size
methodology.raw_price_changes: net_price_change_checkpoints contains raw quote minus exit; checkpoint movement is favourable-direction adjusted
methodology.pip_sizes: ETHUSD 0.1; XAGUSD 0.01; from account-specific broker symbols.pip_position
methodology.checkpoint: last executable-side update at/before horizon, <=6s old; stale/absent quote produces null, never a carried artificial endpoint
methodology.touch_test: compare executable price with original absolute SL/TP, not with 1.38R measured from exit
methodology.native_open: production_sessions::opening_observation_start; metals Asian observation begins 07:01 SGT even though session opens 07:00; 15-second bound
methodology.limitation: observed quote paths, not guaranteed continuous market coverage or hypothetical fills; cash and equity snapshots are separately timed

p AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT DISTINCT account_id,position_id FROM deals WHERE account_id IN(43002148,46130058,47790949,49236051) AND executed_at>='2026-11-10T16:00Z' AND executed_at<'2026-11-12T04:55Z'),
e AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT e.* FROM trading_events e WHERE e.account_id IN(43002148,46130058,47790949,49236051) AND e.received_at<'2026-11-12T04:55Z' AND (e.entry_key IN(SELECT entry_key FROM o) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM p WHERE p.account_id=e.account_id AND p.position_id=e.position_id))),
d AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT d.* FROM deals d JOIN p USING(account_id,position_id) WHERE executed_at<'2026-11-12T04:55Z')
SELECT jsonb_build_object('captured_at',now(),'transaction_read_only',current_setting('transaction_read_only'),
